semantic_cases.name: did_web_domain_transfer_cannot_take_over_existing_pcr
semantic_cases.given: a later controller proves current control of the same did:web full_id but holds no proof from the frozen authority instance
semantic_cases.action: login, reanchor, authorize or revoke a device, write an Event, or erase the old account
invariants: only the current external claim becomes stale

semantic_cases.name: second_server_pcr_cannot_satisfy_old_relationship
semantic_cases.given: PCR-B is independently valid for the same did:web core_id on Principal Server B
semantic_cases.action: use PCR-B evidence for a Realm membership, grant or Contact frozen to PCR-A

semantic_cases.name: webvh_successor_pcr_cannot_substitute
semantic_cases.given: method history validates a legal same-core webvh successor and PCR-B genesis
semantic_cases.action: substitute PCR-B for a business binding frozen to PCR-A without an explicit Realm rebind

semantic_cases.name: did_outage_does_not_block_human_pcr_actions
semantic_cases.given: the DID host and resolver are unreachable while PCR-A frontier is fresh
semantic_cases.action: write a PCR-authorized Event, revoke a device or grant, commit MLS, leave a Realm, or erase the account

semantic_cases.name: did_outage_blocks_only_registered_current_calls
semantic_cases.action: submit a resolution successor, current external claim, DID-governed delegation or enabled DID-root recovery proof

semantic_cases.name: historical_device_evidence_survives_current_rotation
semantic_cases.given: registration accepted-at evidence is valid and the current DID controller has since rotated
semantic_cases.action: verify the frozen genesis and device authorization chain
invariants: using the current key as the genesis key rejects with historical_did_evidence_invalid

semantic_cases.name: resolution_update_requires_both_authorities
semantic_cases.given: a same-core resolution update is proposed
semantic_cases.action: evaluate method successor, exact PCR author and guarded resolution-cell CAS

semantic_cases.name: did_key_human_anchor_has_full_pcr_lifecycle
semantic_cases.action: use account, devices, recovery policy, sessions and PCR Events

semantic_cases.name: did_root_recovery_is_opt_in
semantic_cases.given: a current DID root signs recovery
invariants: authority instance, policy version and PCR generation CAS are mandatory

semantic_cases.name: account_lifecycle_ignores_unrelated_did_failure
semantic_cases.given: the DID is unreachable or deactivated
semantic_cases.action: resume soft logout or erase using the required account/PCR authority
invariants: current DID proof alone is insufficient

semantic_cases.name: role_scoped_did_failure
semantic_cases.given: organization or service current DID delegation is invalid
semantic_cases.action: compare its DID-governed action with an unrelated human PCR action

semantic_cases.name: simultaneous_pcrs_are_partitioned
semantic_cases.given: the same core_id has valid PCR-A and PCR-B on two Principal Servers
semantic_cases.action: operate accounts, devices, recovery, sessions, resolutions and KeyPackages

semantic_cases.name: resolution_response_is_self_contained
semantic_cases.given: a caller requests one principal resolution by principal_id and authority_instance_digest
semantic_cases.action: verify the response without trusting the producer read index
invariants: receipt scope and create Event reverse-bind principal_id and event-derived PCR Realm

semantic_cases.name: resolution_response_rejects_cross_instance_substitution
semantic_cases.given: the response carries a valid same-core authority instance or genesis receipt from another Principal Server or PCR
semantic_cases.action: verify authority and genesis reverse bindings

semantic_cases.name: public_keys_do_not_link_or_classify_people
semantic_cases.given: two authority instances use either equal or different DID/device public keys
semantic_cases.action: infer authority equality or natural-person equality
invariants: v1 defines no cross-PCR link or merge proof

semantic_cases.name: did_call_site_registry_is_exact
semantic_cases.given: operation and event-kind did_authority fields plus the freshness call_sites registry
invariants: risk tier creates no implicit DID call
